name: Auger 0.7.0
body:
Released: 2026-11-25

## New

- Audio and subtitle reports showed the selected tracks, what AVPlay reported playing, caption loading and the outcome of a track switch.
- Buffering reports showed recent stalls, quality changes and recovery attempts. Navigation reports showed the screen and remote actions leading to an error.
- Playback error screens used a local explanation for HTTP problem responses. Playback credentials stayed in the query for stream URLs containing a fragment.

Full technical details in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Artic0din/Auger-Tizen/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md). Need help? See [Reporting Bugs](https://github.com/Artic0din/Auger-Tizen/blob/main/docs/reporting-bugs.md).
